answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an ocean bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every island settlement recomputes the knoll schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
